project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Uppercase project identity; never changed after creation.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; Haze runtime behavior does not read it.

site_address.label: Site address
site_address.help: Human-readable location; it does not select the NEA region.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.help: Singapore site latitude used for onboarding and display, not PSI selection.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.help: Singapore site longitude used for onboarding and display, not PSI selection.

nea_region.label: NEA region
nea_region.help: Explicit regional PSI source; coordinates do not change it.

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: HTTPS listener endpoint; mention delivery derives the mentions endpoint from it.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

wa_group_ids.label: WhatsApp groups
wa_group_ids.help: Comma-separated destinations; required and non-blank before enablement.

alert_only_when_at_least.label: Minimum alert band
alert_only_when_at_least.help: Hourly alert floor; null and good both send every band.

poc_phone_numbers.label: POC phone numbers
poc_phone_numbers.help: Comma-separated international numbers used only for opted-in mentions.

poc_alert_wa_groups.label: POC mention groups
poc_alert_wa_groups.help: Only these destination groups receive mentions; blank fails closed to no mentions.

enable_poc_mentions.label: Mention POCs
enable_poc_mentions.help: Enables severity-gated mentions without changing ordinary delivery.

poc_mentions_at_least.label: Minimum mention band
poc_mentions_at_least.help: Independent severity floor for POC mentions.

advisory_format.label: Advisory format
advisory_format.help: Named message strategy; an unknown value is rejected rather than silently defaulted.

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Master Haze processing switch; the database requires complete delivery configuration before enabling.

four_hourly.label: Two-hourly override
four_hourly.help: Historical column name: guarantees 08:00–20:00 two-hourly slots that bypass band and working-hour gates, but not calendar mutes.

working_hours_start_hhmm.label: Working-hours start
working_hours_start_hhmm.help: HHMM start; must be set together with the end.

working_hours_end_hhmm.label: Working-hours end
working_hours_end_hhmm.help: Exclusive HHMM end; an end before start wraps overnight.

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses scheduled notifications on Singapore Sundays; report-now ignores it.

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses scheduled notifications on configured Singapore public holidays; report-now ignores it.

constraints.name: haze_enabled_delivery_check
constraints.help: An enabled row requires an HTTPS lambda_url and non-blank instance_name, client_id, and wa_group_ids.

constraints.name: haze_working_hours_check
constraints.help: Working-hours start and end must both be null or both valid, unequal HHMM values.
